sections.title: How Delivery Estimates Work
sections.content: Delivery estimates are counted in calendar days from dispatch. Dispatch happens on the same day for orders placed before 2 pm from ShopSmart fulfilment centres. Estimates below are for Standard delivery; One-Day and Same-Day delivery follow the Shipping Policy.

sections.title: West India (IN-WEST)
sections.content: Fulfilment centre: Mumbai. Metro cities (Mumbai, Pune, Ahmedabad): 1 to 2 days. Other cities: 2 to 4 days. Remote pin codes: 5 to 7 days.

sections.title: North India (IN-NORTH)
sections.content: Fulfilment centre: Gurugram. Metro cities (Delhi NCR, Chandigarh, Jaipur): 1 to 2 days. Other cities: 3 to 5 days. Remote and hill pin codes: 5 to 8 days.

sections.title: South India (IN-SOUTH)
sections.content: Fulfilment centres: Bengaluru and Hyderabad. Metro cities (Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai): 1 to 2 days. Other cities: 2 to 4 days. Remote pin codes: 5 to 7 days.

sections.title: East India (IN-EAST)
sections.content: Fulfilment centre: Kolkata. Metro cities (Kolkata, Bhubaneswar): 2 to 3 days. Other cities: 3 to 5 days. North-east and remote pin codes: 6 to 9 days.

sections.title: Cross-Region Orders
sections.content: When the item is not in stock in the shopper's region, it ships from another fulfilment centre and 2 days are added to the estimate.

sections.title: Late Delivery Compensation
sections.content: If a Prime or Premium order arrives more than 2 days after the promised date, the member receives a $5 ShopSmart Wallet credit automatically.
